headline: Access Bank Appoints Oluseyi Kumapayi Deputy Managing Director
summary: Access Bank has appointed Oluseyi Kumapayi as Deputy Managing Director for African Subsidiaries, following approval from the Central Bank of Nigeria.
why: Access Bank Plc is a major financial institution operating across Africa. Leadership changes in key subsidiary oversight roles directly affect regional expansion strategies and profitability.

impacts.name: Access Bank
impacts.why: Appointed a new Deputy Managing Director for African Subsidiaries.
